## featherdrop v2.1.2

A small fix-and-polish release.

## Fixed

- **Copy-link button did nothing over plain HTTP.** The browser's Clipboard API
  only works in a secure context (HTTPS or localhost), so when featherdrop is
  reached at `http://<lan-ip>:3000` the copy silently failed. Copying now falls
  back to a method that works without HTTPS, and the link field selects itself on
  focus so you can always copy manually.

## Changed

- **Accent colour matches the logo.** The primary colour is now the feather's
  gold (`#d4af37`) instead of violet — buttons, the upload progress ring and the
  copy button all pick it up.
